Locate stops along their trips' shapes

Source: R/get_trip_length.R
locate_stops_along_shapes.Rd

Locate stops along their trips' shapes

Usage

locate_stops_along_shapes(gtfs, st, stop_lat, stop_lon, sort_sequence)

Arguments

gtfs

A GTFS object.

st

A data.table with the stop_times of the relevant trips, in which the rows of each trip are contiguous.

stop_lat, stop_lon

The coordinates of the stops listed in st.

sort_sequence

Whether to sort the shapes by shape_pt_sequence.

Value

A numeric vector with the position of each stop along its trip's shape, in meters from the start of the shape. Stops whose trip is not linked to a usable shape, or that don't have coordinates, get NA. Its "shape_points" attribute is a list with the shape points on which the positions were measured (shapes, without missing coordinates and sorted if sort_sequence is TRUE), the rows of each shape in shapes (rows) and the shape_id of each trip (trip_shape_id), in order of appearance in st.
